item.tib: bzlas chog rin chen sgrol ma'i rgyud las tshogs mchod nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter chen
item.coloph: de ltar tshogs mchod nam mkha' mdzod chen 'di/ shar phyogs rgyal mo shing gi rong chen por/ nor lha'i phyogs kyi tha gru 'khrungs pa'i rigs/ tsha ko g.yung drung dpal ldan gyis bskal ngor/ 'gro kun srid mtshor sgrol ba'i grags pa can/ gang des shar rdza'i 'bum smad dgon du bskrun/ mi g.yo bsam gtan gling du dbang phyug lor/ hor zla dang po'i tshes la dge 'gyur cig/
